newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-Taiwan slips as electronics stumble.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-Taiwan slips as electronics stumble.

text.p: Taiwanese global depository receipts fell back on Tuesday, hit by profit-taking in electronics stocks on the local market.
Dealers said the Taiwanese GDR market, dominated by electronics, was hit as tightening short-term interest rates prompted investors to pocket gains following the recent strong run in the sector.
The HSBC James Capel Taiwan GDR index JCEAI shed 4.19 points, or 2.89 percent, to 141.10, representing a discount to the local market of 1.65 percent.
In Taipei, the weighted index fell back through the 10,000 mark, ending down 146.08 points at 9,919.68 as electronics lost 2.67 percent.
Indian GDRs also shed ground on some light profit-taking following recent strong gains, despite a further advance in Bombay. But Ranbaxy bucked the trend, adding 62 cents to $27.00/28.00.
The Capel India GDR index shed 0.71 points, or 0.78 percent, to 90.59, a premium of 21.87 percent to the local market.
The Cazenove Indian GDR index, which measures changes from midday to midday, slipped 0.41 points to 101.93, a premium of 21.98 percent to Bombay.
The Capel Korea GDR index added 0.92 points, or 1.21 percent, to 76.43 in thin dealings. It now stands at a premium of 46.91 percent to the local market.
